description: Updates the specified incident severity level's attributes. Allows modifying the display name, notification triggers (email_trigger, push_notification_trigger), and alert recipient list. The procore_default_name cannot be changed. Pass alert_recipient_ids as an array of Login Information IDs for users who should receive notifications when incidents are created with this severity level.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the incident severity level. Use the `id` from the List Severity Levels response.

name.description: Name of the Incident Severity Level

procore_default_name.description: Procore default name of the Incident Severity Level

active.description: Denotes whether the Incident Severity Level is active

email_trigger.description: Denotes whether an email should be sent

push_notification_trigger.description: Denotes whether a push notification should be sent

order.description: Ranking order of the Incident Severity Level

name.description: Display name for the severity level. Can be customized from the default (procore_default_name).

email_trigger.description: When true, email notifications are sent to alert recipients when an incident is created with this severity level.

push_notification_trigger.description: When true, push notifications are sent to alert recipients when an incident is created with this severity level.

alert_recipient_ids.description: Array of Login Information IDs for users who receive notifications (email and/or push) when an incident is created with this severity level. Replaces the existing alert recipient list.
